claims.head: A tough night ahead for Knies
claims.call: The Hurricanes’ P2 (Slavin and Chatfield) spends at least 52% of its 5-on-5 time against the Blue Jackets’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Hurricanes keep sending Slavin and Chatfield out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Rod Brind'Amour has been picking a defense pair for the other team’s top line. Tonight the Blue Jackets’ first line is Knies, Fantilli and Johnson.

claims.gist: At home, Rod Brind'Amour likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Blue Jackets’ first line.

claims.body: The Blue Jackets’ penalty kill is one of the league’s worst, and the Hurricanes’ power play is near the top. Discipline matters more than usual for the Blue Jackets tonight.

notes.text: Ivan Provorov is on injured reserve (lower body injury) and has not played this season. He is a top-four defenseman. Zach Werenski has taken his spot beside Denton Mateychuk.
Damon Severson was added to the roster on Oct 24 and has played beside Zach Werenski.
Mark Jankowski is day to day (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 3 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Taylor Hall is on injured reserve and has missed the last 4 games. Nikolaj Ehlers has taken his spot beside Logan Stankoven and Jackson Blake.
Seth Jarvis returned in their last game after missing 5 games. Their recent numbers were built mostly without him.
Bradly Nadeau was added to the roster on Oct 15 and has played beside Logan Stankoven and Jackson Blake.
Felix Unger Sörum was added to the roster on Oct 17 and has played beside Jordan Martinook and Nikolaj Ehlers.
Skyler Brind'Amour was added to the roster on Oct 23 and has played beside Nicolas Deslauriers and Eric Robinson.
Seth Jarvis was added to the roster on Oct 23 and has played beside Jordan Martinook and Jesperi Kotkaniemi.
Logan Stankoven has started killing penalties: on the ice for 33% of the team’s shorthanded time in 12 games, up from 1% last season.

CAR.head: The Hurricanes have a lot going for them
CAR.body: Even though Carolina may be without Jankowski, the Hurricanes have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. The Blue Jackets’ way back in is getting good looks.

CBJ.head: The Blue Jackets face a real test
CBJ.body: Even though Carolina may be without Jankowski, the Hurricanes have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. The Blue Jackets can pull it off if they get good looks.

story.head: Kotkaniemi’s favorite opponent
paras: The Blue Jackets come in at 3-5-0, the Hurricanes at 8-2-2.
